A little about me

Bridging engineering
and business operations.

My approach combines technical fundamentals, data-led thinking and an interest in how people, equipment and processes work together.

I graduated in Mechanical and Production Engineering from Ahsanullah University of Science and Technology (AUST). My academic and project experience has exposed me to machine design, thermal-fluid systems, mechatronics, renewable energy modelling and manufacturing processes.

Alongside engineering, I have developed an interest in supply chain and business operations through certification, case competitions, internships and student leadership. I am particularly interested in roles where I can connect shop-floor realities with planning, performance analysis and continuous improvement.

I value clear communication, ownership and evidence-based problem solving — whether I am analysing a simulation, coordinating a team or working through an operational challenge.

Selected work

Engineering projects

A selection of academic and technical projects across mechanical design, robotics, simulation and renewable energy. Each card includes project imagery drawn from the technical work.

Robotics · Mechanism development

Weight-Shifting Rover

Developed a rover concept that shifts its centre of mass to control orientation and stability. Work covered the chassis, rack-and-pinion mechanism, 3D-printed components and Arduino-based control.

SolidWorks · Arduino · 3D Printing
Project contribution

Designed the chassis and rack-and-pinion system, integrated sensors and actuators, and programmed the control logic. The project received 1st Runner-Up at the AUST Mechanical Project Showcasing 2024.

Machine design · FEA

Gear Train Design & Analysis

Designed a two-stage gear reduction system and assessed its torque transmission and structural response under dynamic payload loading.

SolidWorks · ANSYS · Gear Kinematics
Project contribution

Created CAD models and schematic profiles, calculated gear kinematics and applied static structural finite element analysis to examine stress response.

Aerodynamics · Fluid dynamics

Symmetric Airfoil Optimization

Compared baseline NACA 0012 and modified NACA 0011 profiles, studying angle-of-attack behaviour and sensitivity to thickness and leading-edge geometry.

XFLR5 · XFoil · MATLAB
Method & result

Analysed −8° to 8° angle of attack at Re = 1,500,000 and reduced profile thickness from 12% to 11%. The reported result was lower minimum drag while preserving zero-camber symmetry.

Renewable energy · Power systems

Theoretical 150 MW Wind Power Plant

Modelled a utility-scale wind farm to evaluate annual energy yield, monthly generation, grid integration considerations and techno-economic feasibility.

SAM · NREL Wind Data · Energy Modelling
Project assumptions

Selected Lamar, Southeastern Colorado, and modelled a 30 × 5 MW IEC Class II turbine array with approximately 8–10D turbine spacing. Completed year-one energy and diurnal performance simulations.

Renewable energy · Solar thermal

Theoretical 100 MWe Power Tower CSP Plant

Developed a conceptual molten-salt central receiver plant assessment, including solar resource selection, heliostat-field modelling and annual output analysis.

SAM · Global Solar Atlas · DNI Assessment
Project assumptions

Selected Potosí, Bolivia, using Global Solar Atlas direct normal irradiance data as the site resource basis for the theoretical plant assessment.

Mechatronics · Virtual instrumentation

Multi-Domain Simulation Dashboard

Built a unified LabVIEW virtual instrument interface to bring mechanical vibration signal processing and fluid-flow regime simulation into one dashboard.

LabVIEW · System Modelling · Vibration · Flow
Project contribution

Organized block diagrams and front panels into a single software-defined interface to support integrated analysis and faster navigation between simulation domains.
